title: Geo-aware Latency Prioritizer & Safety Preview for Console Routing
creator: Sana Patel
description: Enable customers to author and preview geo-aware routing policies in the Console that prioritize low-latency regions and automatically fall back to compatible model variants. The feature bundles three capabilities: (1) a ‘Latency Prioritizer’ policy node that ranks eligible regions by measured tail latency and cost thresholds, (2) a Safety Preview sandbox that simulates traffic with sampled request traces and shows expected route distribution and cost delta, and (3) an automated rollback guard that suggests safe fallback variants when a route exceeds latency or error SLOs. Aim: reduce customer effort to express latency-first routing while keeping deterministic, reviewable previews before deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Console policy editor includes a Latency Prioritizer node with configurable weighting for latency, cost, and region affinity
Preview sandbox can replay a 1k-sample trace and show per-region latency/CDF, expected QPS split, and estimated incremental cost
Policy validation flags mismatches where requested model variant isn’t available in a target region and surfaces suggested compatible fallbacks
Rollout modal offers a safe-rollback policy that will automatically switch to a specified fallback variant when 95th percentile latency > configured SLO for > 2m
Backend returns a validation summary API (policy_id/preview_id) with human-readable warnings and simulated route decisions
End-to-end tests cover: preview accuracy within 10% of synthetic traffic replay, validation warnings for missing variants, and rollback triggering in simulated failure mode
dev_notes: Backend: reuse routing-sim engine (ENG-8432) but extend to support cost-weighted scoring and model-variant compat checks
API: add POST /policies/:id/preview that accepts a trace sample, cost-tier constraints, and returns simulated decisions
Console: add a composite node UI with sliders for latency vs cost weighting and a dedicated Preview tab with time-series charts
Metrics: emit preview:estimated_cost, preview:region_qps_split, preview:validation_warnings for telemetry
Tradeoffs: sampling larger traces increases preview fidelity but slows UX; start with 1k sample default and allow up to 10k with warning
